Founder real-time: 'lets get MIXFORGE live mixforge.okemily.com'. Added cloudflare_dns_record.mixforge to ops/terraform/main.tf, same pattern as the existing cloudflare_dns_record.iam (DNS-only A record -> 198.58.107.85, so certbot's HTTP-01 challenge can reach this box). terraform validate clean. Not yet applied -- needs TF_VAR_cloudflare_api_token from EMILY/var/cloudflare.md and terraform apply, run by the founder (real credentials, not something this session should run unattended). See MIXFORGE Apple #21056 for the app-level half. commit IDUNA@62fdf74.
